name: AxialGravityEngine
description: Apply acceleration (independent of distance) directed towards an axis.

attributes.name: axisDirection
attributes.description: direction of the gravity axis (will be normalized automatically)

attributes.name: axisPoint
attributes.description: Point through which the axis is passing.

attributes.name: mask
attributes.description: If mask defined, only bodies with corresponding groupMask will be affected by this engine. If 0, all bodies will be affected.
